rust_summary: a model part drawn with an alpha, an overlay, a light and a render type (`native_draw_model_part_with`).
doc_summary: `native_draw_model_part_with(draw, part, sprite, paint)` draws a model as `native_draw_model_part` does, painted by a `NativeModelPaint`: an ARGB colour (a fading mob, `entityTranslucent`), the overlay (the hurt red, a creeper's white flash), a light (full bright eyes) or an energy swirl (a charged creeper). Bundles need "hooks": @API:model_paint@.
